compare.basis: Server totals for completed orders, staff meals excluded — may differ slightly from the sales report screens.
compare.best: {{name}} leaves the most per sale: {{pct}} contribution margin.
compare.clickHint: Click a store to see its menus, order mix and simulator.
compare.gap: Food cost spreads from {{lo}} ({{loName}}) to {{hi}} ({{hiName}}) — a {{d}}%p gap.
compare.notEnough: Comparisons appear once at least two stores have menus with cost. Low readiness below shows where recipes are missing.
compare.redacted: Amounts are hidden for brand managers; ratios are shown.

errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this store’s profitability, or it is not in the plan.

kpi.noCost: No sold menu has a cost yet — link recipes to see what is left per sale
kpi.noPrevious: No sales in the previous {{days}} days to compare
kpi.onCosted: on {{pct}} of sales with known cost
kpi.leftAmount: {{v}} left after food cost and fees

menus.chartLines: Lines = median of {{n}} menus with cost: {{qty}} sold · {{unit}} left per sale. Dot size = net sales.
menus.empty: No menus here for this period.
menus.noCosted: No sold menu has a cost yet, so the matrix is empty. Link recipes (or set a cost) to place menus.
menus.phoneNote: On a phone the matrix is shown as the list below — tap a group above to filter.
menus.unknownHint: Their sales are counted, but what is left per sale is unknown until a recipe or cost is set.

mix.attachTitle: How often each category is in an order
mix.attachWhy: Orders containing the category ÷ all orders. Low side / drink rates are where a set or staff tip helps.
mix.channelOne: Orders made outside PurpleHere (e.g. Grab) are not here.
mix.noCombos: No orders with two or more different menus yet.
mix.optionAttachWhy: Share of order lines with a paid option
mix.setRateWhy: Share of orders with at least one set

page.basis: Server totals for completed orders. Staff meals are a cost, not sales — excluded here.
page.brandShare: Staff cost, rent and profit of a store appear here only when that store shares them (next step).
page.optionsUnknown: {{n}} lines had options with no ingredients linked (counted as 0).
page.thisMonth: This month so far (each store’s time zone).
page.title: Profitability

dog.hint: Sell little, earn little — remove or change the recipe
dog.name: Dogs

plowhorse.hint: Sell a lot, earn little — review price, portion or set
plowhorse.name: Plowhorses

puzzle.hint: Earn a lot, sell little — better spot, photo, staff tip
puzzle.name: Puzzles

star.hint: Sell a lot, earn a lot — keep them visible
star.name: Stars

unknown.hint: Link a recipe to place it
unknown.name: No cost yet

settings.channelHint: For example a delivery partner’s commission on delivery orders taken in PurpleHere.
settings.endMsg: «{{name}}» stops from today. Past months keep it.
settings.feesHint: What the bank / wallet / platform keeps. Empty = 0. Used for what is left per sale.
settings.feesTitle: Payment fees (% of the paid amount)
settings.gtoNote: For mall GTO, check whether the contract counts sales before or after tax — this page uses net sales.
settings.noRules: No costs yet. Add rent first — it is usually the biggest.
settings.rulesHint: Enter once — e.g. «RM6,000 or 13% of sales, whichever is higher». Brand purchases are already in stock costs, do not add them here.
settings.shareFull: Everything, incl. staff cost, rent and profit
settings.shareHint: The brand always sees sales, food cost and menu results. Staff cost, rent and profit are shown to the brand only if you share them (from the next step, when those numbers arrive).

sim.baseFrom: Filled from the last 12 weeks ({{start}} – {{end}}, {{n}} orders).
sim.contributionRate: Left per sale after food cost, discount and fees: {{c}}
sim.goalImpossible: Not reachable with these assumptions — lower costs or raise what is left per sale first.
sim.goalNeed: Needs {{s}} a month — about {{n}} orders a day at {{a}}, or {{a2}} per order at today’s {{n2}} orders a day.
sim.impossibleWhy: What is left per sale ({{c}}) does not cover the sales-based costs — no sales level breaks even.
sim.laborNote: Staff cost {{v}} / month. Linking attendance and pay rates comes in the next step.
sim.mixHint: Menu share of sales — moving them changes the food cost mix (menus without cost use the base rate).
sim.noRules: No rent or cost rules yet — the result ignores them.
sim.ordersNeeded: About {{n}} orders a day at {{a}} per order.
sim.rentSwitch: Rent stays {{a}} up to {{s}} of sales, then {{p}}% of sales.
sim.needFixed: Enter staff cost (left) or add rent in Settings — break-even needs at least one fixed cost.
